why: Trend-led clothing, shoes, accessories, home goods and beauty for 18 to 28 year olds, including its own labels BDG, Out From Under and Kimchi Blue.
origin: Founded in West Philadelphia, across from the University of Pennsylvania in 1970 by Dick Hayne, Scott Belair, Judy Wicks.

craft_evidence.owned: NONE found (the 10-K extract does not mention owned factories; it says UO uses agents and third-party manufacturers and about 4,000 vendors)

craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: first store opened 1970 across from the University of Pennsylvania, West Philadelphia, by Dick Hayne, Scott Belair and Judy Wicks (URBN history page); nothing on where clothes are ma
craft_evidence.process: no (the product pages and URBN brand page cover style and community, not making)
craft_evidence.reasoning: UO designs and buys from about 4,000 third-party vendors; no owned factory, mill or maker is named on any of the 78 sampled pages, 77 of which say only "Imported". One page says Made in the USA. The only dated, placed claim is the 1970 West Philadelphia first store, which is retail history. Nothing checkable about making, so a 1.
